title: Source-bound annular job runner
summary: Reusable caller-driven workflow for source-pinned annular jobs. It performs read-only source and model preflight by default; an explicit write flag enables one isolated guarded construction, source metadata and native readback, save/reopen persistence checks and owned-document cleanup. Synthetic runner tests passed; native use of this runner remains pending.

records.title: Annular job runner implementation
records.summary: Resolves source-job feature paths through caller-supplied named roots, validates annular inputs, rechecks source hashes and selected model inventory before the first mutation, and provides read-only preflight by default. The guarded write route creates one isolated document, captures before save, retains raw entity and SAB evidence before decoding, checks geometry/metadata/persistence, and closes the completed owned documents.

records.title: Annular job runner synthetic tests
records.summary: Fourteen executed synthetic tests cover default no-mutation preflight, source-hash changes before construction, exact inventory row/configuration selection, existing-model and candidate rejection, output and replay receipts, request-ID bounds, read-epoch checks and one-to-one point persistence at the caller tolerance.

records.title: Annular job runner procedure
records.summary: Documents external job and CLI inputs, read-only preflight, explicit guarded execution, source and model gates, saved native evidence, recovery and cleanup scope.

records.title: Annular geometry builder and checks
records.summary: Existing shared helper constructs a plain annulus from the caller's source-bound bore, outside diameter, thickness and frame; it checks analytic cylinders, end planes, boundary loops, connected topology and stored metadata.

records.title: Existing guarded job-runner utilities
records.summary: Provides reused caller-root resolution, portable locators, output/replay checks, audit and save-receipt validation, SAB import preflight, same-request recovery and owned-document cleanup orchestration.

records.title: Existing component model inventory
records.summary: Scans attributed CAD files and candidates and selects the exact component/configuration row used by the annular runner's prewrite gate.

records.title: Existing source readiness and action records
records.summary: Validates external source-feature coverage and pinned file hashes; supplies the existing append-only action-occurrence writer used by the annular workflow.

records.title: Existing guarded OCS client and journal
records.summary: Provides document-bound Client and append-only Journal request identities, state checks and same-ID recovery used by the annular runner.

records.title: Existing guarded OCS geometry adapter
records.summary: Provides the existing cylinder, subtraction and source-metadata operations used by annular_reference; request labels are bounded by the Client namespace limit.

records.title: Existing OCS save/reopen verifier
records.summary: Audits and saves a new DWG, reopens it and checks saved and reopened entity manifests and file hashes.

records.title: Existing native source-metadata comparison
records.summary: Compares the job's expected source identity/frame strings with the native entity metadata stored by the geometry adapter.

records.title: Existing native ACIS/SAB feature reader
records.summary: Reads saved analytic annulus surfaces, end-face boundary loops and closed-body topology from native SAB records after the runner retains the raw record and SAB bytes.

records.title: Existing SAT vertex observation utility
records.summary: Supplies the existing identity-transform SAT vertex reader as a pre-save point-observation fallback when a construction record does not expose SAB before saving.

records.title: Existing owned-document cleanup checks
records.summary: Closes only caller-identified owned documents after matching saved-file hash, persistence receipt and geometry epoch; checks preservation of other open tabs.

records.title: Existing annular geometry helper tests
records.summary: Eight earlier synthetic tests cover annular parameter validation, native analytic observations, stored source metadata and document/revision binding. These tests validate the geometry helper; they do not execute the new job runner against OCS.

records.title: Failed OCS guide request requiring request_id
records.summary: The recorded guide request returned status failed with code request_id_required and the message to supply a unique request_id of at most 128 bytes. No CAD action was executed from this request, and it was not retried.
